title: Burj element meets mizaj
caption:
Fire, earth, air, water. Your burj and your mizaj speak the same old language.

Unani tradition links each mizaj to a classical element, and so does old astrology. So a Safravi Asad is double fire, while a Balghami Hamal is a very interesting mix. Find your element combo on the slides.

Burj content is for fun only: a mirror, not a prophecy.

Comment your burj and your mizaj. Matching or opposites?
